summary.text: Ronnie W. Cromer is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 18, which covers Lexington, Newberry and Richland Counties, serving since April 15, 2003.
He chairs the Senate Banking and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cromer was born on December 1, 1947, in Newberry, and is a pharmacist.
His official page lists a B.S. from the University of South Carolina in 1973 and service as a retired lieutenant colonel in the South Carolina Army National Guard.
He served on the Prosperity town council from 1973 to 1980 and on the South Carolina Board of Pharmacy from 1994 to 2000.
He has been in the Senate since April 15, 2003, and his committees are Banking and Insurance (chairman), Finance, Fish, Game and Forestry, and Rules.
